title: Exp / Linear Decay Transition
description: Finds where a concentration curve leaves a near-linear regime and settles into clean single-exponential decay. Python analysis plus a notebook over average-concentration series, with linear and semi-log fits for the two regimes.

title: SPY / DIA Market Agent Harness
description: An agent harness for running and evaluating market-analysis workflows against SPY and DIA. Focused on repeatable agent loops, tooling around those ETF series, and iterating on prompts and checks without hand-running every trial.

title: Research Paper RAG
description: A RAG system that ingests research papers into a vector database and uses the retrieved context for LLM inference. The agent and vector store are connected; an ingestion API is still to come.
